scope: Official route and GPX-version audit for ten records in the historic/original top-level event list 109–118; this is not the current event-dates.json insertion range 109–118.
rules: Existing GPX files remain valid until a replacement is officially published, downloaded, parsed and validated.
Do not delete or replace historical GPX files during this audit.
Map + GPX pages and download buttons do not count as binary validation.

events.name: Kullamannen by UTMB
events.note: 2027 dates and four distances confirmed directly by UTMB. North Shore is 22 km, not 20. Direct binary download/parse not performed.

events.name: Mallorca by UTMB / Serra de Tramuntana
events.date: 2027 not listed in current official UTMB calendar
events.note: The official calendar and race pages still list 30 Oct–1 Nov 2026. Secondary calendar projections for 2027 are not sufficient to create a new edition. Keep 2026 routes historical.

events.name: Austria Backyard Ultra 24+1 Hochkönig
events.note: First Hochkönig 24+1 event confirmed for 25 Oct 2027 at 16:00. 6.706km loop; 24 standard yards plus a final 25th round. Organizer says route map/track follows.

events.name: Puglia Terra delle Gravine by UTMB
events.note: No 2027 event page or current organizer GPX confirmed in official UTMB calendar. Do not reuse historical Puglia tracks.

events.name: 3 Días Trail Ibiza
events.note: Official Arista Eventos organizer calendar now lists 3 Días Trail Ibiza for 26–28 November 2027. The detailed 3diastrailibiza.com schedule and route pages still show the 2026 edition; do not carry those 2026 course details or GPX files into 2027. For the 2026 event, stage GPX was sent to registered participants by email because routes cross protected/private land.

events.name: Oman by UTMB
events.note: Official races page still shows 10–12 Dec 2026. FAQ allows deferral to a following 2027 edition if force majeure prevents 2026 race; this clause alone does not confirm 2027 event/date. Do not mark 2026 routes as 2027.

events.name: Mammutmarsch München
events.note: Official organizer confirms Saturday 31 July 2027, start/finish TV Planegg-Krailling. Two routes 75 and 100 km; no public GPX link visible on event page.

events.name: Megamarsch München
events.note: Official page confirms 15–16 May 2027, 100 km from Munich to Garmisch-Partenkirchen, within 24 hours. Route is released as Komoot download about two weeks before event and can change shortly before start.

events.name: Vietnam Highlands Trail by UTMB
events.note: Official page confirms four main distances and updated actual course lengths. Organizer schedule includes an additional 5K on 10 Jan; add only if event database is intended to include fun runs. Older one-click Google Drive links still require actual import/parse test.

events.name: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB
events.note: Official entry page confirms 13–14 Feb 2027 and five distances. T102/T50/T21/T14/TMiler. Exact current GPX binaries not downloaded or parsed.

followUps: Kullamannen: test and parse four official 2027 GPX files, especially verify 168/108/53/22 km.
Mallorca: keep 2026 routes historical; monitor only for an explicit 2027 UTMB announcement.
Hochkönig 24+1: recheck organizer for route map and GPX publication.
Puglia: keep inactive/unconfirmed unless official 2027 announcement appears.
3 Días Trail Ibiza: recheck after 2026 race for 2027 date and organizer email GPX rules.
Oman: await official 2027 event calendar and updated race pages.
Mammutmarsch and Megamarsch: obtain participant Komoot/GPX routes when organizer releases them; validate after download.
Vietnam Highlands: test Drive imports, compare official distance values, and decide whether 5K fun run belongs in event database.
Tarawera: export each of five official GPX tracks and parse before marking validated.
